name: pokit-note
description: Install the plugin, open Authenticate on the Pokit Note MCP, sign in on Pokit Note in the browser, and choose Allow. Grok Bot can then show, create, and edit your notes, lists, and recipes.

POKITNOTE_API_BASE.title: Pokit Note address
POKITNOTE_API_BASE.description: The Pokit Note server Grok Bot should use. The plugin connects to this address at /mcp/. Staging is the usual address. Change it if your account lives somewhere else. Do not add a trailing slash.
